en: An old monochrome postcard view of a historic German town. In the foreground there is a stone path with a low wall, a gate, and a man standing near the entrance to a courtyard shaded by a large tree. Behind this are simple houses with gabled roofs and flower boxes. In the upper left rises a more elaborate building with steep roofs, turrets, and decorative windows, while in the background two tall Gothic church spires dominate the skyline. Printed red text at the top gives the location and viewpoint, and a vertical red imprint along the right edge appears to be the publisher's information. On the façade of one of the upper buildings is signage for a wine tavern.
